example.yaml:
id: germline
name: Germline variant calling
version: 1.0.1
application: genomics
description: Paired FASTQ through alignment, duplicate marking, BQSR, haplotype calling and basic quality filtering. GRCh38 references and a pinned tool image are provisioned by the administrator.
image: /opt/hpc/images/genomics-1.0.0.sif
references:
  fasta: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/genome.fa
  fasta_index: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/genome.fa.fai
  fasta_dict: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/genome.dict
  bwa_amb: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/genome.fa.amb
  bwa_ann: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/genome.fa.ann
  bwa_bwt: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/genome.fa.bwt
  bwa_pac: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/genome.fa.pac
  bwa_sa: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/genome.fa.sa
  known_sites: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/dbsnp.vcf.gz
  known_sites_index: /opt/hpc/references/GRCh38/dbsnp.vcf.gz.tbi
inputs:
  reads_r1: {kind: fastq, required: true, description: Paired-end sample read 1, FASTQ or FASTQ.gz}
  reads_r2: {kind: fastq, required: true, description: Paired-end sample read 2, FASTQ or FASTQ.gz}
parameters:
  sample_id:
    type: string
    default: SAMPLE001
    format: sample_id
    description: Read group and VCF sample identifier
  threads: {type: integer, default: 4, minimum: 1, maximum: 64}
  memory_gb: {type: integer, default: 8, minimum: 4, maximum: 512}
  time_minutes: {type: integer, default: 120, minimum: 1, maximum: 10080}
resources: {cpus: 4, memory_gb: 8, time_minutes: 120}
steps:
  - id: align_and_sort
    command: >-
      bwa mem -t {{param:threads}}
      -R '@RG\tID:'{{param:sample_id}}'\tSM:'{{param:sample_id}}'\tPL:ILLUMINA'
      {{reference:fasta}} {{input:reads_r1}} {{input:reads_r2}}
      | samtools sort -@ {{param:threads}} -m 256M -o {{run_dir}}/aligned.bam -
  - id: mark_duplicates
    command: >-
      gatk --java-options '-Xmx2g' MarkDuplicates
      -I {{run_dir}}/aligned.bam -O {{run_dir}}/dedup.bam
      -M {{run_dir}}/duplicate_metrics.txt --CREATE_INDEX true
  - id: base_recalibration
    command: >-
      gatk --java-options '-Xmx2g' BaseRecalibrator
      -R {{reference:fasta}} -I {{run_dir}}/dedup.bam
      --known-sites {{reference:known_sites}} -O {{run_dir}}/recalibration.table
  - id: apply_recalibration
    command: >-
      gatk --java-options '-Xmx2g' ApplyBQSR -R {{reference:fasta}}
      -I {{run_dir}}/dedup.bam --bqsr-recal-file {{run_dir}}/recalibration.table
      -O {{run_dir}}/recalibrated.bam
  - id: haplotype_caller
    command: >-
      gatk --java-options '-Xmx2g' HaplotypeCaller -R {{reference:fasta}}
      -I {{run_dir}}/recalibrated.bam --native-pair-hmm-threads {{param:threads}}
      -O {{run_dir}}/raw.vcf
  - id: variant_quality_filter
    command: >-
      gatk --java-options '-Xmx2g' VariantFiltration -R {{reference:fasta}}
      -V {{run_dir}}/raw.vcf --filter-name LowQual --filter-expression 'QUAL < 30.0'
      -O {{output:variants}}
outputs:
  variants: {path: results/germline.filtered.vcf, kind: vcf, required: true}
